MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK
  INTERNATIONAL FRIENDSHIP COMMISSION
  March 10, 2026

Chair Carbajal called the meeting to order at 5:12 p.m. in Conference Room 4, Norwalk
City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to roll call were Vice
Chair Gomez, Commissioner Flores, and Commissioner Salas. Also, present were Ozzie
Ramos, Deputy City Manager, Amber Bulosan, Management Analyst, and Svetlana
Hernandez, Office Assistant I.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Chair Carbajal motioned for the approval of the minutes of the International Friendship
Commission Regular Meeting minutes that was held on February 10, 2026. Vice Chair
Gomez seconded the motion.

MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Chair Carbajal, Vice  Chair  Gomez,  Commissioner  Flores,
  Commissioner Salas
NOES:  None
ABSENT: None
ABSTAIN: None

REPORTS

Potential Programs and Partnerships

The Commission discussed the possibilities of potential Sister Cities. Vice Chair Gomez
presented ideas for potential Sister Cities. The Commissioners also discussed how they
can establish programs and partnerships, through outreach of the community, like at City
events.

STAFF COMMENTS

Recap of CSU-Sister Cities Virtual Conference

Staff discussed topics that were presented during the virtual conference hosted by
California State University, Long Beach and Sister Cities. Ms. Hernandez shared with the
Commissioners the school’s program of digital connection with their Sister City. The
digital pen pal program is a way to promote intercultural exchange by creating an
opportunity of global learning without the need for travel.

Sister Cities International Southern California Quarterly Regional Meeting
 Staff invited the Commissioners to the Quarterly Sister Cities virtual meeting. The meeting
will be held via Zoom on Saturday, March 28, 2026 from 10:00 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.

COMMISSIONER COMMENTS

No Commissioner comment

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

No public comment

ADJOURNMENT:

Being no further business to come before the International Friendship Commission, the
meeting was adjourned at 5:44 p.m.

_______________________________
CHAIR
Maria Carbajal
